text: Your first daughter will always be more like her father. Not only in her face. In her character. She does not like being told what to do. She is independent, strong, determined.

And that is exactly why she clashes with her mother. She is the feminine version of the man you chose to love. His same temperament. His same way of reacting. So when you argue with your daughter, you are often arguing with a reflection.
But I want you to understand something. That character that drives you crazy is what will protect her in life. That strength that tires you out is what will hold her up when you are no longer there.

And if every argument leaves you empty, my friend, it is not that you love her less. It is that you have been without peace for too long. An exhausted body has nothing left to give, so every small friction becomes a war.

The next time you argue, breathe, and look at her closely. Recognise in her the best of what you gave, and the best of what you chose. Everything I know is inside The Quiet Between Thoughts. The link is in my profile.
